text:
maya: FYI deploybot scheduled a kernel+quant swap to matmul-tiling-v3 in staging at 23:00 UTC. This includes a quant encoding tweak and a matmul tiling refactor. Requesting small canary (0.5%) and explicit rollback criteria. Note: perf risk on long sequences (>1500).

liam: Please share artifact SHA and short RN blurb.

maya: sha: deadbeefcafebabe. rn: 'matmul-tiling v3: refactor tiling loops for cache locality; quant encoder patch to stabilize int8 paths. Improves short-seq latency, watch long-seq throughput.'

olivia: Running quick perf job now. Short seq (<=512) p50 -6%. Long seq 1536 p95 +12% in a few nodes. Attaching logs to the ci run: /s/ci/tiling/4567.

arjun: set canary slice to 0.5% for 30m, hold expansion unless stable for 30m. Gate: p95 > baseline*1.4 OR error ppm > 400 -> immediate rollback. Also request kvcache-hit gating: drop >3% absolute hitrate -> rollback. Pin region us-east-1 for the canary.

kevin: Quick smoke snippet for bench: ```wrk -t8 -c100 -d30s --latency 'https://staging-api.redwood/v1/gen?model=matmul-tiling-v3'``` run before and after, compare p95.

benchy: add telemetry check for kv-cache evictions and scheduler backpressure. Long seq regressions usually show evict spikes.

deploybot: DeployBot: queued matmul-tiling-v3 -> staging canary slice=0.5% start=23:00UTC region=us-east-1

liam: Also mark release notes: "rollback criteria included; delayed prod rollout until one clean night-window canary."

maya: acknowledged. I'll add pin-ttl=8h for canary to avoid accidental expansion.

deploybot: DeployBot: canary started slice=0.5% at 23:01UTC -> active. Observability: /dash/eng/matmul-tiling-v3/canary.

olivia: 23:07 initial pass for short seqs looks good. Long seq alarms at 23:09: p95 ~1.5x baseline on nodes a,b. kvcache hitrate down 4%.

arjun: This is crossing our kvcache gating. Manual decision time.

liam: Recommend abort canary and pin back to matmul-tiling-v2 for staging. We can reopen when perf patch lands.

maya: Do it. deploybot, pin matmul-tiling-v2 -> staging region=us-east-1 reason='canary kvcache hit drop and p95 regression'

deploybot: DeployBot: pin applied. Traffic reverted to matmul-tiling-v2. Canary aborted.

kevin: I'll file a checklist for repro steps and local repro command in the PR: include long-seq workload and reproduce kvcache eviction trace.

olivia: Opening a perf PR: add tile-size heuristics, add regression test for seq=1536, and a smoke job in ci-nightly.

maya: Thanks team. Delaying prod rollout. We'll target a re-run after the PR lands and one healthy 1% canary. Updating release notes and notifying product.
